title: 第7章 乌鳞蟒第8章 中品灵液
lines: 门窗紧闭，许辰坐在床榻之上，身前摆放着十个储物灵戒。
其中六个储物戒来自流云宗弟子，一个来自血手屠夫，一个来自天剑宗弟子，剩下两个分别来自秦泰和秦静的师兄。
每一个储物戒中的资源虽然不多，但加起来，绝对颇为可观。
“12304块灵石，黄阶低级灵丹17颗，黄阶低级灵药7株，黄阶中级灵药1株……”
“我现在的修为还只是练气九重巅峰，仗着吞噬帝诀之威，不惧凝气境一二重武者，但凝气境三重之上的武者，我万万不是他们的对手。”
“水府开启，无数武者蜂拥而来，我这点实力明显捉襟见肘，力有不逮。”
许辰看着铺满一地的灵石，灵丹，灵药。
河底裂开数道狰狞口子。
一座水府逐渐显露在众人视线之中。
无数道炽热的目光，死死盯着这一幕。
人群中，不知是谁喊了一句。
霎时间，无数道人影冲出，向着水府疯狂冲去。
一头巨大怪蛇席卷着滔天妖气，自水中冲出。
巨蛇张开血盆大口，冲在最前面的一名武者，避之不及，直接被吞入腹中。
content_en:
Sand River Town.
Inn.
The doors and windows were closed, Xu Chen sat on the bed, with ten storage rings placed in front of him.
Six of the storage rings come from Liuyun Sect disciples, one is from Bloody Hand Butcher, one is from Tianjian Sect disciple, and the remaining two are from senior brothers Qin Tai and Qin Jing respectively.
He's looked at them all.
Although the resources in each storage ring are not many, when added up, they are definitely quite considerable.
"12,304 spiritual stones, 17 low-level yellow elixirs, 7 low-level yellow elixirs, and 1 intermediate yellow elixir..."
Xu Chen's breathing was slightly rapid.
"My current cultivation level is only at the peak of the ninth level of Qi training. Relying on the power of the Devouring Emperor Technique, I am not afraid of warriors at the first and second levels of the Qi Condensation Realm. But for warriors above the third level of the Qi Condensation Realm, I am absolutely no match for them."
"The Water Mansion is open, and countless warriors are swarming in. My strength is obviously stretched, and I am unable to cope with it."
Xu Chen looked at the spiritual stones, elixirs, and elixirs spread all over the ground.
A thought came to my mind.
The Devouring Emperor Technique operates silently.
…
Sand River Town.
The west.
Thirty miles away.
The river is moving.
Countless people gathered by the river.
suddenly~
The earth shook.
Several hideous holes opened at the bottom of the river.
The river flows back.
Water levels dropped rapidly.
A water palace gradually appeared in everyone's sight.
Countless blazing eyes stared at this scene.
"Shuifu is born!"
Someone in the crowd shouted something.
"Come on!"
"Haha, I'm one step ahead."
In an instant, countless figures rushed out and rushed towards the water mansion.
"Boom!"
The river suddenly exploded.
A huge monster snake rushed out of the water, sweeping away the overwhelming evil aura.
"Hiss~"
The giant snake opened its bloody mouth and rushed towards a warrior at the front. He was unable to avoid it and was swallowed directly into its belly.
